open_loop_type: skeptic's pre-printed return label (did she send it back?)
story_structure: skeptic hook (brand at 1%) / guarantee as the only reason she ordered / symptom scenes (grocery cart) / first use / kept it
offer_close: 90-day guarantee carries the hook
notes: Short (3k). Turns the guarantee into the story's hook: 'ordered only because of the guarantee; return label printed'. Usable with our 30-day MBG.
